tools.name: get_financial_context
tools.description: Read-only compact FinancialContext JSON. Includes status.position, status.accounts, transaction index total/months, recurring, budgets, goals, snapshots, liabilities, holdings, and health. The status.position field is a point-in-time (as-of-date) balance snapshot, separate from transaction and behavior windows. A null position means no position snapshot is available. Transaction items are not inline; use get_transactions for items.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Read-only transactions from the FinancialContext artifact. Pass exactly one of `period` or `periods`. Use `period: "latest"` for the fixed 10-day window, `period: "YYYY-MM"` for one month, or `periods` for two or three distinct months. Multi-month output contains one month page per requested period in input order. The latest window is not caller-configurable. Months outside the covered range return an error.

period.description: Use "latest" for the fixed 10-day window or a YYYY-MM month when periods is not provided. A month outside the covered range returns an error.

periods.description: Use two or three distinct YYYY-MM months for one read. Pass periods instead of period. Months outside the covered range return an error.

tools.name: search_operations
tools.description: Search the supported Warm operation catalog. Use this first to find the smallest matching operation.

query.description: Words describing the action or data you need.

tools.name: describe_operation
tools.description: Describe one operation, including its input schema and risk. For write operations, pass the exact intended input to receive an approval with its ID, status, URL, and expiry.

input.description: Exact intended input. Required to obtain approval for a write operation.

tools.name: invoke_operation
tools.description: Invoke one previously discovered Warm operation. Every write operation requires the approval_id returned for the exact same input by describe_operation.

input.description: Exact intended input. Required to obtain approval for a write operation.

approval_id.description: Approval ID returned by describe_operation for the exact write input.
